changelog.category: Default Dark Theme & Pure Liquid UI (v1.7.7)
items: Enforced default dark theme (#0F172A) and 92% page zoom level across the music application.
Guaranteed 100% full screen width and height coverage with zero side or bottom whitespace gaps.
Redesigned navigation bar, topbar, floating dock, and music controllers to Pure Liquid UI aesthetics.
Preserved 100% of existing music streaming and playback logic.
Bumped service worker cache version to v114.
